test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined word segment.**

He seems __to be undecided__ about whether to move to another city for better prospects.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Sitting on the fence'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate idiom for the underlined word segment "**undecided**" is:** Sitting on the fence.**
 
• Explanation: "**Sitting on the fence**"
